source_of_truth: data/brand-directory/stick (Brand Bible Draft v3 + Campaign OS Full Brand Bible Workbook 2, September 2026)

big_brand_idea.name: Better Begins Here.
big_brand_idea.belief: Everything has to earn its place.

brand_essence: Better golf for a new breed of golfer.
brand_purpose: To open the door to better golf for people who want to improve, while rejecting the outdated idea that serious golf must come wrapped in stuffy culture, legacy gatekeeping, and expensive nonsense.
brand_mission: To help golfers get better through: smart coaching · player-first fitting · properly matched equipment · modern product curation · a welcoming, high-performance environment. STICK matches equipment to the player, not the player to the equipment.
brand_vision: To become the benchmark for modern golf culture and performance retail in South Africa — credible, culturally relevant, technically sharp, accessible, distinctive.

brand_archetype.rationale: Challenges outdated golf norms with substance. Not a punk brand. Not an engineering robot. Edge and brains.

personality_shorthand: Smart, rebellious, and serious about enjoying better golf.

brand_values.name: Attitude
brand_values.summary: STICK has edge. Does not ask traditional golf culture for approval. Not decoration — it's the reason for existing.

brand_values.name: Precision
brand_values.summary: Takes golf seriously. The game is technical. Equipment, data, setup, details matter.

brand_values.name: Access
brand_values.summary: Serious golf must be more open. Quality product, great advice, and meaningful improvement across budgets and backgrounds.

brand_values.name: Honesty
brand_values.summary: Speaks plainly. No hype. No fake luxury theatre. No pretending expensive means better.

brand_values.name: Progress
brand_values.summary: Obsessed with improvement. Golfers improve. Game evolves. Brands evolve. Culture evolves.

positioning.category: Modern golf performance retailer and culture brand
positioning.statement: STICK is where modern golfers come to thrive.

differentiation: Quality across price points (Takomo, Vice alongside premium OEM)
Curation is different (Takomo, Vice, Psycho Bunny — brands traditional shops ignore)
Environment matters (dark matte, wood, stone — modern studio, not pro-shop)
Culture is changing and STICK reflects that

tone_rules: Smart: Use expertise without showing off.
Modern: No stale golf phrases. No fake heritage voice.
voice.punctuations: Sentence case for headlines. No full stops where brevity serves. No exclamation marks except genuine excitement. Comma-tight.
voice.humour_level: Wry, confident — never clownish. Edge comes from attitude, not punchlines.
voice.emoji_policy: Rare. Only when tone genuinely needs it. Never as substitute for personality.
voice.profanity_policy: None. The attitude makes profanity unnecessary.
voice.south_african_cues: Light. Occasional local reference (Winelands, Paarl, Cape Town). Never braai-ad. Feels SA through place and product truth.

supporting_lines_verbatim: Everything has to earn its place.
This is why we stock it.
Your driver is telling you something.
Why this shaft? Because your current one is costing you 15 metres.

messaging_hierarchy.master: STICK is where modern golfers come to get better — and everything has to earn its place.

commercial_messages.message: Club fitting (driver, iron, wedge, putter, shaft)
Workshop services (custom builds, loft/lie, regripping, shaft work)

trust_messages: TrackMan data in every fitting — real, explainable numbers
Workshop precision — Built at Stick (loft/lie, swing-weight, shaft prep)
Fit First principle — match product to player, not player to product
Multiple price points — Takomo, Vice alongside premium OEM. We do not push expensive by default.

seasonal_campaigns.message: Psycho Bunny, bags, putters as gifting

proof_points: Not a traditional shop — combines fitting, coaching, workshop, retail and culture under one roof with editorial curation.
Real attitude — does not ask traditional golf culture for permission.
Fitting data and workshop evidence are real: TrackMan, build sheets, specs.
Multiple price points — Takomo, Vice alongside premium OEM.
Partners with brands traditional shops ignore (Takomo, Vice, Psycho Bunny).
Physical environment deliberately modern: dark matte surfaces, wood, stone.
Founding team are fitters, coaches and builders — in-house expertise.
GBP generates real local interactions (1,100+ Mar-Aug 2026).
Fit Fact campaigns produced leads at R20-R32 each — education model works commercially.
version: September 2026 (Brand Bible Draft v3 + Campaign OS Full Brand Bible Workbook 2)

visual_identity.border_style: 1px thin borders in charcoal or muted grey
visual_identity.icon_style: Line icons 1.5-2px stroke, rounded terminals, no filled/duotone
visual_identity.look_feel: Performance minimalism with attitude. Dark indoor studio. Diffused key light, controlled shadows. Product as hero. Slight desaturation.

recurring_properties.name: Why It's Here.
recurring_properties.purpose: Explain why Stick chose to stock a product or partner brand. Editorial reason behind every priority item.
recurring_properties.visual_rules: Product name lock-up + 'Why It's Here' title frame. Clean product shot. One-line reason. Use case. Stick verdict.
recurring_properties.min_run: 6 weeks per priority brand, 8+ executions across 3+ formats

recurring_properties.name: Fit First.
recurring_properties.purpose: Demonstrate that clubs/shafts/putters are chosen through fitting, not guesswork.
recurring_properties.visual_rules: Problem/baseline club first. TrackMan data overlay. Before→After comparison where possible.
recurring_properties.min_run: Continuous — every performance product should have a Fit First angle available

recurring_properties.name: Built At Stick.
recurring_properties.purpose: Show workshop precision: custom builds, loft/lie, regripping, shaft work. Turn craft into content.
recurring_properties.visual_rules: Workshop detail shot. Job title overlay. Finished spec card. Before/after where visual.

recurring_properties.name: Ask Stick.
recurring_properties.purpose: Utility/education. One golfer question gets one clear answer. Myth-busting, doubts, buying advice.
recurring_properties.visual_rules: One question headline. One answer. No filler. Product or fitting detail if relevant. Simple typography.

recurring_properties.name: Style That Belongs.
recurring_properties.purpose: Apparel and lifestyle. Show that style and performance belong together. Psycho Bunny.
recurring_properties.visual_rules: On-golfer shot or flat lay. Fabric close-up. Outfit context. Brand + Stick lock-up.
recurring_properties.min_run: 6-week minimum per campaign cycle. Rotate seasonally.

recurring_properties.name: Product Drop.
recurring_properties.purpose: New stock or limited availability. Timely product reveal.
recurring_properties.visual_rules: Fast reveal / product-first. 'Product Drop' title. Availability + message route. No generic 'new in'.
recurring_properties.min_run: As stock arrives. Minimum 3 executions per drop.

audience.primary: The 'Any Golfer' — wants to improve, curious about equipment, values expertise over brand prestige, open to modern brands, sees golf as part sport/part identity/part culture.
audience.secondary: The Culturally Curious Golfer — drawn to modern golf style, new brands, welcoming environment, less intimidating entry point.
audience.excluded: Golfers who only care about old-school brand prestige, want the same tired pro-shop experience, equate seriousness with formality, or treat golf as a social costume.

internal_brand_standard: Does this help golfers get better?
Does this feel like the future of golf rather than the past?
Does this avoid empty golf snobbery?
Does this feel sharp, confident, and credible?

lane_system.name: Why It's Here
lane_system.description: Real product features from Stick's curated catalogue. Each product earns its place on the rack.

lane_system.name: Fit First
lane_system.description: The fitting process + outcomes. A fitting is the start, not the sale.

lane_system.name: Ask Stick / Better Begins Here
lane_system.description: Coaching + education content. Questions, myth-busting, technique.

lane_system.name: Built At Stick
lane_system.description: Workshop events, club building, custom work, on-site experiences.

lane_system.name: Style That Belongs
lane_system.description: Apparel + lifestyle. How you look on the course / at the range.

lane_system.name: Product Drop / Book / Enquire
lane_system.description: Direct-response: drop launches, fitting bookings, retail enquiries.

lane_system.name: Human / Trust
lane_system.description: Staff, fitters, real moments. The people behind the standard.

lane_system.name: Paid Media
lane_system.description: Boosted posts + retargeting. Always in service of one of the above lanes.

lane_system.name: Search / SEO
lane_system.description: Owned content that compounds: articles, FAQs, comparison guides.

lane_system.name: CRM / Lifecycle
lane_system.description: Email + WhatsApp to existing customers. Repeat purchase, retention, loyalty.

monthly_themes.question: When every club in the bag has to earn its place — what's in yours, and why?
monthly_themes.supported_bet: Fitting + curation drive conversion; brand authority over volume.
monthly_themes.what_we_prove: Customers trust Stick to filter what's worth carrying. We curate, we don't sell.
monthly_themes.what_changes_it: If fitting bookings drop 30% week-on-week, or product mix shifts away from curated lineup.
